title: Maximum Performance of a Team

monster.name: Synergy Colossus
monster.title: Multiplier of Team Efficiencies
monster.defeatQuote: Sorting by decreasing efficiency and min-heap of speeds maximized score!

description: You are given two integers `n` and `k` and two integer arrays `speed` and `efficiency` both of length `n`. There are `n` engineers. The performance of a team is the sum of their engineers' speeds multiplied by the minimum efficiency among their engineers. Return the maximum performance of this team at most `k` engineers modulo `10^9 + 7`.
starterCode:
def maxPerformance(n: int, speed: list[int], efficiency: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def maxPerformance(n: int, speed: list[int], efficiency: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    import heapq
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    engineers = sorted(zip(efficiency, speed), reverse=True)
    speed_heap = []
    speed_sum = 0
    max_perf = 0
    for eff, spd in engineers:
        heapq.heappush(speed_heap, spd)
        speed_sum += spd
        if len(speed_heap) > k:
            speed_sum -= heapq.heappop(speed_heap)
        max_perf = max(max_perf, speed_sum * eff)
    return max_perf % MOD
hints: Sort by decreasing efficiency. Use min-heap of size at most k for speeds.
